name: Optoma 1080p
notes: Measured with the PJLink console on 2026-10-24, on the device itself. AVMT only looks at the first digit and toggles: 2x switches the sound, 3x the picture (reported as 31 while hidden) — whatever the second digit says. 30 hides a visible picture, 31 brings a hidden one back. AVMT 11/10 answer ERR1; 3x is never acknowledged, 2x is acknowledged with OK. 2x has no visible effect while the picture is hidden; the sound comes back as it was. The reported state follows a command only after 1-2 s. CLSS answers "Class 1". Class 2 commands and unknown commands get no answer at all instead of ERR1. POWR never reports 2 (cooling) or 3 (warming): after POWR 0 it reports 0 at once and accepts POWR 1 straight away; after POWR 1 it keeps reporting 0 for about 23 s and then 1.
